On PDA Xác nhận đơn, enter five known trailing digits from a real PickListCode such as PL... and press KIỂM TRA PICKLIST.

actions.title: Field-test D085 sticky multi-Agent HA, anti-spam, WMS session reuse, overlay rollback and autostart
actions.provider: Physical Beta PDA + Windows Agents + authorized Supra WMS sessions
actions.reason_owner_only: Connected tools cannot physically boot multiple company/user laptops, operate PDA devices, validate the Owner-proven desktop overlay behavior, or authenticate an authorized company WMS browser session.
shortest_test_path: Run released Agent v10 on at least two normal-user Windows sessions and establish valid authorized WMS sessions on both.
Verify exactly one Agent is ACTIVE and the other remains STANDBY; repeated PDA lookups stay on the same ACTIVE Agent.
Close/kill the ACTIVE Agent during a controlled lookup; after about 10 seconds verify PDA shows Đang chuyển người xử lý... and standby takes over the pending request.
Stop all WMS-ready Agents and verify PDA shows Không có Agent xử lý online and instructs the Picker to go to the specialist desk.

Use controlled nonexistent five-digit values to verify three final NOT_FOUND results in 60 seconds trigger 5-minute lock; subsequent lock episodes escalate to 30 then 60 minutes. Do not use production-impacting mutation actions.

Restart Agent/Windows user session and verify Agent starts automatically without elevation; if the dedicated WMS browser profile session remains valid, Agent restores it and preloads Picklist without requiring a fresh login.
Verify overlay uses the prior working behavior and Cài đặt bảng nổi is available directly on the Agent main window.
pass_criteria: Transport remains the current temporary RTDB carrier; no final D078 transport choice is made by this test.
One sticky WMS-ready active Agent handles all jobs; standby does not touch WMS jobs until failover.
Failover threshold is approximately 10 seconds and pending work is resumed.
No-Agent and switching states are visible on PDA.
Cache hit avoids WMS lookup; concurrent cache misses do not create parallel full scans.
Anti-spam lock is account-scoped and persists across PDA/app/Agent restart.
Agent auto-start requires no Windows administrator/elevation.
WMS raw session/header values are absent from repo/logs/RTDB.
No WMS confirmation/mutation occurs.
actions.safety: Beta only. Use authorized WMS sessions. Never paste passwords, cURL, tokens, Authorization/APISID/SID/SCID/USID, signatures/nonces or raw WMS response payloads. Stable and WMS mutation remain forbidden.

actions.title: Field-review D086 Agent session/UI/click-through/persistent background behavior
actions.provider: Physical company Windows laptop + authorized Supra WMS session + Beta PDA where needed
actions.reason_owner_only: Connected tools cannot operate the Owner's company Windows desktop, authenticate the company WMS browser, click through a real overlay onto another application, use Task Manager, or measure the physical laptop's idle footprint.
shortest_test_path: Use the released relay-agent-v11 normal-user EXE after CI/release PASS.
Review Tổng quan: only Đăng nhập hệ thống Supra, connection/Agent status and current-model information should be primary; ADMIN login, tests, overlay and logs must be under Cài đặt.
After one authorized WMS capture, restart Agent and verify it decrypts the local session file, validates/preloads Picklist and does not reopen browser while the saved session remains usable.
Invalidate/expire the saved session and verify Agent clears unusable state then opens the local dedicated WMS browser to reacquire authorization.
Lock overlay over a real desktop icon/application control and click through it; the underlying object must receive the click. Unlock and verify drag works.
Verify there is no normal window X shutdown. Use Tắt Agent... and confirm wrong password is rejected and current ADMIN password allows graceful exit.
Restart Agent, kill only the main Agent process and verify the watchdog relaunches it; do not interpret this as protection against killing both processes.
Observe idle CPU/RAM on the weak laptop and provide sanitized log only if behavior is abnormal.
pass_criteria: No raw WMS session/password/token values appear in repo/logs/RTDB; WMS session file is DPAPI CurrentUser encrypted.
Valid saved session restores Picklist readiness without browser; invalid saved session falls back to local browser.
Overview/Settings hierarchy matches D086.
Locked overlay truly passes pointer input to another application/desktop beneath it.
Graceful exit requires current ADMIN password verifier; plaintext password is not persisted.
Unexpected main-process exit is restarted by watchdog while deliberate exit/update/shutdown is not.
Idle monitoring avoids old 4-second netsh polling; no material continuous CPU load from UI monitoring.
D085 10-second failover/cache/rate-limit behavior remains unchanged.
No WMS confirmation/mutation occurs and Stable is untouched.
actions.safety: Beta only. Use authorized company WMS access. Never share passwords, Authorization/Token/APISID/SID/SCID/USID, signatures/nonces, encrypted session files or raw WMS payloads.
